thread:
Priya (Content): ok team, we need a tight plan to ship updated copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages + the post-launch comms and webinar signup routing. goals: clarity for devs, obvious CTAs, and correct inbound routing.
Maya (Marketing): agree. can we land 3 hero lines + 2 CTAs per page by EOD tomorrow? :clock1:
Jon (Growth): timeline works. I also want 3 short social post variants and 1 webinar blurb. keep language performance-led.
Ali (Sales): important: leads from webinar form need a vendor tag + tier field so we route correctly. Hosted -> SDRs, Dedicated -> AE queue, Private -> Enterprise CS.
Sam (Product): small ask: include a short note about model parity across modes ("same API, tuned infra"). that reduces confusion.
Priya (Content): draft hero options below — pick one per page + CTA variants. feedback inline pls.
Priya (Content): Hosted hero options:
- "Hosted API: instant production LLMs with predictable latency and usage-based pricing."
- "Ship faster with a managed inference API — low latency, scale on demand."
CTAs: [Start free] / [Compare tiers]
Maya (Marketing): second hosted hero reads better to me. short and actiony.
Priya (Content): Dedicated hero options:
- "Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput, reserved GPUs, SLA-backed latency."
- "Reserved GPU pools for production at scale — predictable cost and isolation."
CTAs: [Reserve capacity] / [Request pricing]
Ali (Sales): add phrasing about "enterprise networking" for Private variant").
Priya (Content): Private hero options:
- "Private deployment: VPC & on-prem inference with audit logs and KMS integrations."
- "Air-gapped and VPC-ready inference for regulated workloads and strict controls."
CTAs: [Contact sales] / [Schedule demo]
Jon (Growth): social copy prototypes (3 each):
1) "New: ship LLM features with predictable latency. Hosted, Dedicated, Private — one API. RSVP for a quick webinar: [link]"
2) "Production-first inference is here. Learn how to cut per-token costs and keep SLAs. Join our webinar."
3) "From dev to enterprise: how one API meets every compliance and scale need. 30-min demo + Q&A."
Maya (Marketing): love 1 & 3. use short UTM examples in links: ?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Priya (Content): webinar blurb for landing and post: "Join our product leads for a 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference: deployment modes, cost controls, and rollout best practices. Bring prompts and deployment Qs."
Sam (Product): add a 10-minute ops segment covering rollout policies + fallback behaviors. attendees likely ops folks.
Ali (Sales): inbound form mapping (proposal):
```
form fields -> crm fields
email -> contact.email
company -> account.name
region -> account.region
mode_interested -> lead.custom.mode
tier -> lead.custom.tier
utm_campaign -> lead.utm.campaign
```
Priya (Content): recommend a hidden `mode_interested` prefill per page: hosted pages prefill=hosted, dedicated page=dedicated, private page=private. then routing rule: if mode_interested == private -> tag EnterpriseSales; dedicated -> tag AE; hosted -> SDR.
Maya (Marketing): routing notes: also create Slack alerts for Private leads into #sales-enterprise and add a high-touch follow-up task in CRM.
Jon (Growth): A/B test CTAs for Hosted: [Start free] vs [Try hosted API]. set success metric = signup -> 7-day active dev.
Priya (Content): FAQ bullets to add under each page (short): Hosted: onboarding + quotas; Dedicated: autoscale + burst; Private: deployment models + KMS.
Sam (Product): can we add a one-line perf benchmark block? e.g. "p99 latency < 200ms for common requests" with a footnote. legal can vet.
Priya (Content): next steps: 1) pick final hero per page (Maya) 2) pick CTA variants to A/B (Jon) 3) ops to confirm form field mapping (Ali) 4) publish social + webinar page + routing rules (Maya + Ali).
Maya (Marketing): i'll pick heroes by noon PDT tomorrow. I'll also draft the three social posts and webinar registration page.
Ali (Sales): i'll validate CRM field names and set up routing rules. will loop in @ops when ready.
Sam (Product): i'll prepare the quick perf/rollout slide for the webinar.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled campaign deploy window tomorrow 17:00 UTC. react with :rocket: to confirm readiness.
Priya (Content): :rocket: thanks all — I'll update the copy doc and drop the link here when it's ready.
